results.title: US Envoys Witkoff and Kushner Arrive in Kyiv for First Visit
results.description: US special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner arrived in Kyiv on Sunday, Sept. 6, marking their first visit to Ukraine since the full-scale Russian invasion began. Arriving by train at the capital’s central railway station, the envoys were greeted by senior Ukrainian officials, including Presidential Office head Kyrylo Budanov, Foreign Intelligence Service chief Rustem Umerov, and parliamentary faction leader Davyd Arakhamia.
